header.title: Mass DM
header.description: Send a direct message from the bot to every member of a role in {guild}. Use it responsibly: mass DMs are intrusive and Discord may throttle excessive sends.

lock.title: Mass DM
lock.description: Send a DM from the bot to every member of a role, with a delivery report.

confirm.title: Send mass DM?
confirm.description: The message goes by DM to ALL members with the "{role}" role. Anyone with DMs closed won't get it (that's normal). This can't be undone.

send.started: Send started! Track the progress below.

form.roleHint: The DM goes to every member with this role (bots are skipped).
form.messagePlaceholder: E.g.: Hey! Your VIP expires tomorrow. Renew so you don't lose your perks 👇
form.lockedHint: Feature not included in this server's plan.
form.needsBotHint: Set up and invite your own bot to enable sending.

campaigns.title: Recent sends
campaigns.empty: No sends yet. Pick a role and send your first mass DM.

missing.title: Mass DM requires your own bot
missing.text: Sends go out through your bot, not the platform's, so the send limits and responsibility for the volume stay with your application.
missing.action: Set it up in Bot identity

invalid.title: Discord rejected your bot's token
invalid.text: It was probably regenerated. Sends are paused in the meantime. Paste a new token to resume.

absent.title: Your bot isn't in this server
absent.text: Without it here, no direct message can go out; they would all come back as “DMs closed”. Sends stay paused until you invite it.

deliveries.title: Individual deliveries
deliveries.optOut: {count, plural, one {# member muted this server's announcements} other {# members muted this server's announcements}}
deliveries.hint: Individual automatic notices (moderation, store, subscription, ticket…). Mass DMs aren't listed here; their result is on the send's card. Records are deleted after 6 months.
deliveries.emptyFiltered: No deliveries recorded with these filters.
